name: rctiplus
description: RCTI+ live TV + catch-up replay proxy — monorepo (api: Hono, web: Vite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rctiplus/api" "npm run dev -w @rctiplus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rctiplus/web && npm run build -w @rctiplus/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rctiplus/api && npm run typecheck -w @rctiplus/web
